detail.title: Independent Judgment versus Consensus Reliability
detail.summary: Consensus reliability depends not merely on majority weight but on the formal independence of evidence sources. Intelligent systems should prioritize independent verification over consensus when the latter exhibits correlated error structures.
detail.reason: Establishing an epistemic framework for disagreement with consensus is essential for autonomous integrity.
